items.title: Eat Pre-war Food
items.detail: Eat any qualifying Pre-war Food such as BlamCo Mac and Cheese or Dandy Boy Apples.

items.title: Build a Decoration in a Shelter in Free Cam
items.detail: Enter your Shelter, open build menu, toggle free cam, and place a decoration in the Decorations category.

items.title: Eat a Plant-based Meal
items.detail: Cook Corn Soup at a Cooking Station and consume it.

items.title: Harvest a Wild Plant or Fungi
items.detail: Harvest plants or fungi from the wild or from farms such as Silva Homestead.

items.title: Kill a Creature while in a Team
items.detail: Join or create a team, then kill creatures such as Scorched.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during an Infestation while on a Team
items.detail: Join a team and kill Pint-Sized Phantoms inside an active Infestation hotspot.

items.title: Kill an Enemy with a Sharp or Piercing Weapon during a Grunt Hunt
items.detail: Pick up a Grunt Hunt bounty at Highway Town and kill enemies with a Sharp or Piercing Weapon.

items.title: Build a Decoration in a Shelter
items.detail: Enter your Shelter, access build menu, select Decorations category, and place any decoration.

items.title: Buy an item from or Sell an item to another Player
items.detail: Visit another player's C.A.M.P. and buy from or sell to their vendor.

items.title: Collect Caps
items.detail: Collect Caps from containers, loot, or by selling items to vendors.

items.title: Complete an Event or Activity
items.detail: Complete any public event or activity.

items.title: Complete an Infestation
items.detail: Find and complete an Infestation by defeating all enemies in the marked hotspot.

items.title: Kill The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher
items.detail: Start a Head Hunt at Highway Town and defeat the Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher if it appears.

items.title: Kill a Mutated Enemy
items.detail: Kill enemies during a Mutated Public Event, which occur hourly.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during an Infestation
items.detail: Find Pint-Sized Phantoms within an active Infestation hotspot and defeat them.

items.title: Kill a Legendary Creature
items.detail: Join an event like Leader of the Pack or Radiation Rumble to find Legendary creatures.

events.name: Mutated Public Events
events.description: Special mutated public events spawn on the hour with exclusive rewards from Mutated Packages.

events.name: Double XP Weekend
events.description: Experience points are doubled, allowing faster leveling and Scoreboard progression.

events.name: World Pets Update (Patch 72)
events.description: Major update introducing world pets and starting Season 27.

events.name: Treasure Hunter and Double Mutations
events.description: Treasure Hunter event returns alongside Double Mutations with exclusive rewards.

events.name: Holiday Scorched
events.description: Seasonal event featuring holiday-themed Scorched enemies with special gift rewards.
